provenance: AWA v8 plan — 'System-Wide Operator Egress Gate' section. Pinned VERBATIM in P0 so no banned term silently drops between the plan and the consumer's egress config before the egress-phase test is built.
rationale: The FULL plan inventory the future `egress`-phase test (CR10) will CONSUME. The SHARED contract intent-constitution.v1.json.banned_terms deliberately holds only the generic Tier A/B subset (zero-link / shared-first: the shared router names no single consumer's tokens); the concrete Tier C on-disk leakers are FIRST-CONSUMER (AWA) contributed and pinned here. This file is a reference checklist, NOT a frozen contract floor (it is not a *.v1 contract and is exempt from the freeze-lock). The egress test composes tier_a + tier_b + every consumer's tier_c and asserts ZERO occurrences across the seven PM-facing surfaces, each expressing honest confidence (what was / was not checked) — never a bare green implying an unauditable safety guarantee.

tier_c_consumer_concrete.note: Concrete on-disk leakers contributed by the FIRST consumer (AWA). Other consumers add their own tier_c list; the shared tiers above are never shrunk.

honest_confidence_note: Beyond zero-banned-terms, each surface must state what was and was not checked (honest confidence). A bare green check that implies an unauditable safety guarantee is itself a CR10 violation, tested at the egress phase.
additive_note: Tiers only EXTEND (a new banned term is additive; an existing one is never removed). Adding a consumer to tier_c_consumer_concrete is additive. This checklist grows; it never shrinks.
